about: The cloud models each agent can use with its own login or an API key, with the effort levels each takes in that agent's words (efforts: [] none, null not known: the agent's own levels). Made from each agent's documentation and model lists and models.dev; a model not listed can always be typed.

claude.name: Claude Code
claude.note: Aliases follow the installed Claude Code; the 1M-context variants (opus[1m]) cannot be named with --model here (brackets).

models.name: Opus plan (opus in plan mode, then sonnet)

codex.name: Codex
codex.note: Your ChatGPT login or an OpenAI API key; Codex fetches OpenAI's current list itself (models_cache.json).

opencode.name: OpenCode
opencode.effort_note: per model in opencode.json (a model's options, or its variants: Ctrl+T in the TUI)
opencode.note: provider/model as models.dev lists it; any other provider OpenCode knows can be typed.

opencode2.name: OpenCode 2
opencode2.effort_note: per model in opencode.json (a model's variants)
opencode2.note: provider/model as models.dev lists it; any other provider OpenCode knows can be typed.

hermes.name: Hermes Agent
hermes.note: The Nous Portal's models (OpenRouter's names); with another provider (hermes model) its own names, typed.

dsh.name: DeepSeek Harness
dsh.effort_note: a model route's reasoningEffort (off, low, high, max) in a cordis.patch.yml

qwen.name: Qwen Code
qwen.note: Qwen OAuth's one model, or DashScope's (an API key, as Qwen Code's modelProviders); Qwen Code clamps an effort to what the model takes.

goose.name: Goose
goose.note: The provider's own model name (GOOSE_MODEL; the provider comes with --api-key or goose configure); Goose maps its effort onto each provider itself: no levels per model here.

openhands.name: OpenHands
openhands.note: LiteLLM's provider/model (with one --api-key the provider prefix is added when missing).

nanobot.name: nanobot
nanobot.note: anthropic/MODEL (nanobot's own default form), OpenAI's, Gemini's and DeepSeek's own names, OpenRouter's vendor/model; the provider comes with --api-key.

letta.name: Letta Code
letta.note: Model handles provider/model; Letta Cloud's own catalog (api.letta.com) was not reachable when this list was made.

pi.name: Pi
pi.note: provider/id (Pi's --model); Pi clamps a thinking level to what the model takes.
